title: 2026-08-03 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference (独立, 解耦推理KV缓存传输拓扑感知)、TokTier: Exact Stateful Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving (CMU, 有状态分词消除编码代理重算)、ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression (中大深圳, 残差统计重建被驱逐token贡献)、Mixture-of-Translators: Translating KV Caches Across Heterogeneous LLMs (KAIST, 跨架构KV缓存翻译框架)、Don't Mix Rewards Mix Policies: Policy Decomposition for Multi-Reward RL (CASIA, 策略空间分解多奖励RL)、SERPO: Self-Evolving Rubric Policy Optimization for Open-Ended TTRL (上交, 评分表自进化测试时强化学习)、BLADE: Boundary-Expanded Dynamic Exit for Efficient LLM Reasoning (北邮, 多粒度边界动态早退推理)、TransMem: Transforming Hidden States into Memory for LLMs (中山, 隐状态参数化记忆模块)、Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents (港中文, 零token记忆操作)、TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs (Google, 文本-多模态一致性gap基准)
